title: Watch This Before Getting a Second Remote Job
description:
30-Second Overemployed Audit: Jumpseatjobs.com/readiness 

Are you cutout for Overemployment? I think not. 

This video is a 10 step test that will confirm if you could pull off two remote jobs at the same time. 

Uploaded from a cafe in Mexico City called "Cafe Inu". Entirely based on Shibas and I was lucky enough to have three walk in while working. 

P.S. New upload schedule is going to be every Friday.
